I been farming this land 35 years, so I know what works here in Quzhou. My main crop is cotton — that's what my system is built around. But I also got maize, wheat, and stevia going. With 64 mu that's a lot of ground to cover, and with 6 people at home and some working in town, I gotta think careful about money and labor.

Cotton is my big one. I'll put about 35 mu in cotton this year, same as before. I use hybrid seed from the dealer in town — Lumianyan or similar, costs more but the bolls are bigger and pest resistance is better. Cotton needs nitrogen but not too much or it goes to leaf instead of bolls. I put 2 bags of compound fertilizer (about 40 kg N) plus topdress with urea at squaring. I water 4 times from the well — planting, squaring, flowering, boll. Spray maybe 6-7 times for bollworm and aphids, that's just how it is here.

Maize I plant about 12 mu, summer season after wheat. Hybrid Zhengdan or Xianyu, everyone uses these. I put one bag compound (about 20 kg N) at planting and topdress urea at big trumpet stage, total maybe 18 kg N. Water twice from well if no rain. Spray 2 times.

Wheat about 12 mu winter, improved variety Jimai. Plough deep, fertilize with compound at sowing, topdress in spring. Water 2-3 times. Need 14 kg N or so.

Stevia about 5 mu — this one I learn from neighbor who started growing it for the company contract. Need more careful management, water more, fertilize moderate.
